name: Erasers: Converging Destinies
source:
"Do you believe Magic existed in old medieval times?
If so... where is it in today's technological world?

Someone.. must have Erased it."

A Millenia later... Magic has returned to Modern Society 

A new chaotic world is born. 20 years later, 2 decades since magic's return. Now everything that came with the wonder of magic is back to bless, and haunt mankind, including monsters and the fabled curse of the Crimson Calamity.

[from [url=https://zankizuna.itch.io/erasers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你相信，中世纪曾存在魔法吗？
如果存在…在如今的科技世界，它又去了哪里？

一定有人…将它抹除了。”

一千年后…魔法重返现代社会。

一个全新的混乱世界，诞生了。又过了20年，距离魔法回归，已整整两个十年。伴随魔法奇迹的一切，也再次降临，赐福人类，纠缠人类，包括怪物，以及传说中“绯红灾厄”的诅咒。

[摘自[url=https://zankizuna.itch.io/erasers]itch.io[/url]]
